GET /A_SupplierQuotation: Gets the header details of all supplier quotations in the system.
POST /A_SupplierQuotation: Creates a header of a supplier quotation with the details passed in the request body.
GET /A_SupplierQuotation('{SupplierQuotation}'): Gets the header details of a supplier quotation.
PATCH /A_SupplierQuotation('{SupplierQuotation}'): Changes the header details of a supplier quotation.
DELETE /A_SupplierQuotation('{SupplierQuotation}'): Deletes a complete supplier quotation.
GET /A_SupplierQuotation('{SupplierQuotation}')/to_SupplierQuotationItem: Gets details of all items from a supplier quotation.
GET /A_SupplierQuotationItem: Gets details of all items from all existing supplier quotations.
GET /A_SupplierQuotationItem(SupplierQuotation='{SupplierQuotation}',SupplierQuotationItem='{SupplierQuotationItem}'): Gets the item details from the supplier quotation.
PATCH /A_SupplierQuotationItem(SupplierQuotation='{SupplierQuotation}',SupplierQuotationItem='{SupplierQuotationItem}'): Change the item details in a supplier quotation.

GET /A_SupplierQuotationItem(SupplierQuotation='{SupplierQuotation}',SupplierQuotationItem='{SupplierQuotationItem}')/to_SupplierQuotation: Gets the header information of the supplier quotation that includes the specified items.
POST /Submit: Submits a supplier quotation.
POST /Complete: Completes the bidding process.
POST /Cancel: Cancels a supplier quotation.
POST /SubmitForApproval: Submits a supplier quotation for approval.
POST /CreateFromRFQ: Creates a supplier quotation from an RFQ.
